audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is keccak256 deterministic and collision-resistant?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch (EL vs CL): keccak256 determinism/collision-resistance for MPT state tries is an Execution Layer (EL) concern. The target codebase is Prysm, a Consensus Layer (CL) Go client. The EL Python MPT trie functions (keccak256 as used in state tries, encode_node, patricialize, etc.) do not exist in this CL codebase.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is keccak256 collision resistance maintained?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch (EL vs CL): keccak256 collision resistance for MPT state tries is an EL concern. Prysm is a CL Go client and does not implement EL Merkle Patricia Trie operations.
